source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: atrial escape rhythm typically 50–60/min; P morphology depends on origin.
implementation_basis: Existing authored PAC ectopic P-prime contour; no focus localization
invariants: One ectopic P replaces every sinus P
No PAC timing or compensatory pause
Normal narrow QRS and repolarization preserved
Regular1:1 conduction and single mechanical event per beat
Projection, event-budget atomicity, wire and phase recovery
limitations: Established rhythm only; no first escape after a long pause
No anatomical focus assignment or wandering rhythm
Physiology demo integration and pump calibration remain open
